A real `nginx -t` is not available on the Mac and is not claimed: it is the runbook's first gate. Nothing live changed. Evidence 0.8 MB. Landed attended, hash unchanged; the cutover (deploy, droplet write on the owner's word, route deletion, public verification, Cache Rule) is the next act `reviews/goldrush-static-route-1.md`.
